releases.changelog:
Added

- Archive Viewer editor for .zip, .jar, .war, .ear, .aar, .apk, .whl, .nupkg,
  .vsix, .xpi, .ipa, .epub, .tar, .gz, .tgz, .bz2, .tbz2, .tbz, .xz,
  .txz, .zst and .tzst; formats are recognised by their bytes, 7-Zip, RAR, lzip, .Z and
  .cab get a clear "not supported" message.
- ZIP: end record search with self-extracting prefixes, ZIP64, data descriptors, Unix modes and
  symlinks, Info-ZIP Unicode paths and extended timestamps, NTFS times; stored, Deflate, bzip2
  and Zstandard entries with a CRC-32 check; encrypted and other methods are named, not unpacked.
- TAR: ustar, GNU long names and links, PAX headers, base-256 sizes, symbolic and hard links;
  GZIP (several members), bzip2, XZ and Zstandard streams, with the tar inside or a single file
  named from the GZIP header, each GZIP member checked against its CRC-32 and size. Unpacking
  stops at 512 MB; archives inside archives open up to 8 levels deep and 1 GB together.
- Clear messages for valid files beyond the decoders' limits: Zstandard windows over 128 MB, XZ
  dictionaries over 64 MB, and XZ with a SHA-256 check or BCJ or delta filters. A damaged or
  cut-off GZIP file shows what could be read with a notice.
- Names without UTF-8 marking in CP437, CP866 (default for a Russian UI) or Windows-1251,
  switchable in the toolbar.
- Virtualized file tree with size, packed and date columns; filter (⌘F / Ctrl+F), expand
  and collapse all, summary with the compression ratio, keyboard navigation.
- Preview: text with line numbers and wrapping, images, hex dump, details (method, date,
  permissions, CRC-32, link target); archives inside archives open in place with a trail back;
  Save… through Orca's save dialog and Copy path. The README is selected on opening.
- English and Russian UI, Orca's light and dark themes, plugin and tab icons.

plugins.description: Browse archives in Orca's editor tabs: .zip, .jar, .apk, .whl, .epub and other ZIP files, .tar, and .gz, .bz2, .xz or .zst (also .tar.gz and friends). A fast file tree with sizes and dates, a filter, previews of the text, images and hex inside, nested archives, legacy code page names and saving single files. Read-only, offline.

releases.changelog:
Added

- .avi opens in Media Player instead of "Binary file — cannot display". The tab converts it to MP4 offline when it opens (FFmpeg in WebAssembly decodes, the browser's WebCodecs encoders write H.264 or VP9 with Opus or AAC) and shows the progress. Video: Xvid, DivX 3/4/5, MPEG-4, H.264, H.263, MJPEG, MPEG-1/2; sound: MP3, MP2, AC3, AAC, PCM, ADPCM, surround mixed down to stereo. Unsupported codecs and damaged files get a clear message.

Changed

- License is now MIT AND LGPL-2.1-or-later: the bundled FFmpeg decoder (vendor/ffmpeg) is LGPL; its source and build script are in wasm/.

releases.name: Media Viewer
releases.changelog:
Added

- File icon theme "Media Viewer" (Settings → Appearance → Icon theme): video and audio files get their own icons in tabs, the file tree, Quick Open and search, even when Orca's built-in player opens them. It maps only media files; other files show Orca's built-in icons while it is selected.
- Tabs opened in Media Player show a video or an audio icon instead of the plugin icon.

Changed

- Media Player is split into video and audio editors (media, media-audio, media-plus, media-plus-audio) so each gets its tab icon.

releases.name: Media Viewer
releases.changelog:
Added

- Icon, cover and screenshots for the plugin page in Orca and on orca.dev.

Changed

- File info shows "— (measured during playback)" for the frame rate until the clip has played, instead of a guessed "≈ 30 (unknown)".

releases.name: Media Viewer
releases.changelog:
Added

- Media Player for video and audio in Orca's editor tabs, opened from the file tree, chat file links or orca file open.
- Opens .mkv, .mka and .weba by default (Orca has no viewer for them).
- Offered in the tab's view toggle for .mp4, .m4v, .mov, .webm, .mp3, .wav, .m4a, .aac, .ogg, .oga, .flac and .opus, keeping Orca's built-in player as the default.
- Controls: play/pause, seek, volume and mute, speed 0.25×–3×, repeat, frame stepping, fit / actual size, full screen.
- Save the current frame as PNG through Orca's save dialog.
- File info overlay: size, resolution, duration, measured frame rate, type.
- Audio cover in place of a black frame.
- Keyboard shortcuts, light and dark themes, English and Russian UI.

plugins.description: Video and audio in Orca's editor tabs: plays .mkv, .avi, .mka and .weba, which Orca cannot show (AVI is converted offline in the tab), and adds a full player view to .mp4, .mov, .webm, .mp3, .flac and other media. Speed, frame stepping, repeat, frame snapshots, file info and keyboard shortcuts.
